reader.requirement: At --std 85 GENERATE data-name-1 must be accepted only when data-name-1 names a TYPE DETAIL report group (an 01-level report group entry), optionally qualified by its report-name, and refused for any other report group type, a subordinate report entry, a non-report item, a file-name or an undefined name.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 adds the one-detail-group limit of the report-name form (§1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR6); not on the data-name arm
Edition.Has(2002): the GLOBAL-FD rule for a containing program's report (2002+ only); 1985 asks nothing

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/Edition.Has/Edition.Edition over ReportWriterBinder.cs and ReportGroupResolution.cs (Resolve uses the EditionContext only to report diagnostics); ReservedWords.Table.cs lists GENERATE continuous since 1985.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for SR1 itself: the data-name arm (detail-kind test, COBOL0899; not-a-group, COBOL1757; ambiguity, COBOL1920) is the same at 85 and 2023. The edition-switched arms on the same statement are the report-name form's one-detail limit (85 only) and the contained-report FD GLOBAL rule (2002+).

reader.notes: The data-name arm resolves through the one report-group funnel and refuses every non-detail target at 85 exactly as at 2023. Diagnostic texts cite §2023:14.9.16.3 SR1 rather than the 1985 clause at --std 85 (wording only, not a conformance defect).

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-166/r7amb.cob: DTL2 is both an 01 TYPE DE report group of RD RPT and a 05 item under WS-G in WORKING-STORAGE; 'GENERATE DTL2.' (and 'MOVE "X" TO DTL2.') compiles and runs with EXIT 0 at --std 85 (runs/r7amb-001) and at --std 2023 (runs/r7amb-002). §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 requires a unique reference for every explicitly referenced user-defined name ('Identical user-defined names may appear in a source program; however, uniqueness must then be established through qualification for each user-defined name explicitly referenced'), so unqualified data-name-1 here does not name a type detail report group; it must be written DTL2 OF RPT. ReportGroupResolution.Resolve looks only at the report models, so COBOL1920 fires for a name in two RDs (the reader's p2gen) but never for a report group that collides with a non-report data-name. The reader's own requirement counts 'an ambiguous unqualified group name refused' in SR1's range. Other attacks held: r1gen 'GENERATE DTL OF PRT' (file-name qualifier) and 'GENERATE DTL OF WS-G' refused COBOL1757; r2genok an elementary level-01 detail (PIC/COLUMN/SOURCE on the 01) refused COBOL2247 citing §1985:XIII.3.9.3, correct since 1985 Format 1 (01) carries no PICTURE. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR1 (the text is in SR1); OK §1985:IV.4.3.8.1 (the text is in the clause; it lies in SR3).
refuter.corrected: Not CONFORMS: under-rejects. GENERATE data-name-1 unqualified, where data-name-1 also names a non-report data item, is accepted at --std 85 although the reference is not unique (§1985:IV.4.3.8.1) and so does not name a type detail report group (§1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR1). Cause (b): same at --std 2023. The ambiguity test in src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/ReportGroupResolution.cs#Resolve considers report groups only. If the inventory files uniqueness under IV.4.3.8.1 rather than SR1, the defect moves there and SR1 itself is otherwise implemented. No kb/Work note found (searched COBOL1920, ReportGroupResolution, working-storage collisions: PB365, PB4109, PB5524 are other defects).
